name: Small Pure Titan
description: Short, fast and often childlike in proportion. Easy for a trained soldier to kill alone — if they don't hesitate.

name: Standard Pure Titan
description: The most common class. Mindless, sunlight-driven and capable of breaking through a wooden door but not a wall.

name: Large Pure Titan
description: Heavy enough to uproot trees and fast enough to catch a horse. ODM gear strongly advised; a blade to the nape is still advised more.

name: Abnormal
description: Ignores humans to pursue a fixed goal — a wall, a building, a face it remembers. Unpredictable, and therefore the deadliest kind.

name: Wall Titan
description: A hardened Colossal Titan embedded in the walls, dormant for a century and waiting for a single command.

name: Titan Shifter
description: A Subject of Ymir who can transform at will and regenerate. Only a shifter can inherit one of the Nine — by eating its previous holder.
